name: Tahan
title: Descendant of Ephraim
summary: Tahan was a son of Ephraim and the founder of the clan of the Tahanites. He is mentioned in the genealogies in Numbers as one of the clan leaders in the tribe of Ephraim. Little is known about his personal life beyond his place in Ephraim's genealogy.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Ephraim
keyEvents.description: Tahan is listed as a son of Ephraim and the ancestor of the Tahanite clan in the census on the plains of Moab.

keyEvents.title: The inheritance of the tribe of Ephraim
keyEvents.description: As one of Ephraim's descendants, Tahan was part of the tribe that received its allotted portion in the Promised Land during the conquest of Canaan.

keyEvents.title: The Tribe of Ephraim in the Census
keyEvents.description: The Tahanite clan was counted as part of the tribe of Ephraim during the second census in the wilderness, led by Moses and Eleazar.

keyEvents.title: Joseph's Blessing over Ephraim
keyEvents.description: Ephraim, the ancestor of Tahans, was blessed by his grandfather Jacob, who placed the younger Ephraim before the older Manasseh, a decision that would affect all of Ephraim's descendants.
